title: Thai-Inspired Pizza with Mushroom, Bell Pepper & Peanut Sauce

steps.text: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper along with the mushrooms.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Arrange flatbreads on a large baking sheet pan; evenly spread with peanut sauce, then top with veggies and cheese.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until pizzas are warmed through and cheese is melted, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates. Enjoy!
